target_customer: Custom screen printers and decorators buying blank garments from wholesale distributors (free to end users per the launch post)
problem: Decorators juggle several distributor accounts with account specific prices and must check each site for price, stock and shipping.
business_model: Free to users at launch; monetization not stated
product_category: Purchasing comparison portal for blank apparel

founders.name: Ian Hinkley
education: MIT, double major in mechanical engineering and business
founders.background_notes: Said to have been a purchaser at a custom apparel shop (Printavo article).

exit.reason: Not stated; a July 2025 podcast episode says it was shut down

technical_complexity.rationale: Connecting to distributor accounts and normalizing account specific prices and inventory needs integrations or scraping across several vendors, standard but fiddly engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Distributors own the pricing and could restrict access; the tool had no data of its own and relied on users' existing vendor logins.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Distributors consolidated (S&S bought alphabroder, per a 2026 vendor blog); no source shows them copying the comparison wedge.

market_need_then: Decorators have account specific distributor pricing and no standard way to compare; the founder cited his own experience as a purchaser. Printavo covered the product in April 2024.

branding.community_and_virality: Printavo ran a podcast article on the founder in April 2024 and a trade podcast covered the shutdown in July 2025.

brand_strength.rationale: Acronym name with a memorable analogy tagline; trade press coverage existed but the brand was not a growth driver.

outcome_analysis: DGI Apparel built a free comparison portal for screen printers and reportedly served thousands of shops before shutting down by mid 2025. No source gives the cause, and the one directory line on user counts is unverified. Distribution_failed is a weak inference from a free product with no stated revenue; the cause is not public.
notes: Funding: VCBacked lists a $500K pre-seed with YC, Liquid 2 Ventures and SBXi; CB Insights lists a $0.5M convertible note dated 2024-01-01; sources disagree on form and date, and rest on databases only. Shutdown date unknown (podcast episode dated 2025-07-09). Competitor search found PromoHunt style tools but nothing dated near the batch, so the list is empty. The dgiapparel.com page now only shows a title.
